message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and quality is where that is proven. Our options tie a firm quality commitment to a price with no chargeback per complaint, so you carry no penalty exposure on the bearing brackets.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. Your offered commitment is far looser than the quality we already measure, while Option A asks for a commitment you can plan for, at a price in line with what we have paid before.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. I can drop our price to EUR 46.00 for this package to get things moving. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, we can offer a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.64.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
